text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service

AUSTRALIA, Nov 25 - The Maritime Union of Australia will hold a national stopwork meeting on 26/11 from 0700 to 1400 hours. At this stage, only Port Kembla will be affected. Tugs, lines, stevedores in Port Kembla will hold stopwork meeting on 27/11 from 0800 to 1200 hours.

COAL - Queensland, Abbot Point - berth vacant. Vessels due by 20/12, no delays. Dalrymple Bay - two vessels loading, 4 waiting, 17 vessels due by 10/12, approx. 2-3 Days delay. Hay Point - one vessel loading, 1 waiting, 8 vessels due by 6/12, approx. 1 Days delay. Gladstone - R.G. Tanna - at approx. 1600 hours on 24/11 the shiploader in no. 2 berth received major chute damage and will be down for repairs until approx 30/11. To effect these repairs, no. 2 Berth will close to all shipping until 30/11. During this period, loading will bearried out only in no. 1 Berth. Two vessels loading, 1 waiting, 20 due by 20/1/97, approx. 1-2 days delay. Barney Point - one vessel loading, 4 vessels due by 6/12, No delays. Brisbane - berth vacant, 1 vessel due 1/12, No delays.

New South Wales - Newcastle - Kooragang 2 vessels loading, 6 waiting, 15 vessels due by 10/12, approx 3-4 Days delay. Channel dyke 2 vessels loading, 1 waiting, 19 vessels due by 9/12, approx 1 Days delay. Port Kembla - one vessel loading, 3 waiting, 7 vessels due by 4/1/97, Approx 3-4 days delay.

IRON ORE - Western Australia - Port Hedland - shippers advise that commencing 3/12, the lump re-screening plant will be shut down for a period of 60 hours to allow for the changeout of the lrp splitter chute. The shutdown will commence at the completion of loading of the lump portion of vessels at berth on 3/12. Vessels at anchorage or arriving during this period will be delayed at anchorage. Mt. Newman, Nelson Point berth A 5 vessels due, berth B 1 vessel loading, 1 anchored, 6 due by 3/1/97, 8 other vessels due with no eta. Goldsworthy (Finucane Island) 5 vessels due by 3/1/97. Dampier - Parker Point 1 vessel loading, 2 anchored, 1 due 27/12. E.I. Island 1 loading, 1 anchored, 2 due by 26/12. Ten vessels due for Dampier. Port Walcott - one vessel loading, 1 berthed, 6 due by 9/12.
